Hi all, Yury will give a zoom lecture in the Rutgers Lean seminar this 2024-02-07T13:00:00-05:00. All are welcome. (Is there a way for me to post the zoom link so that only people signed in to zulip can access it, and not the general public? In the meantime, please DM me for the link.)

Speaker: @Yury G. Kudryashov

Title: What's missing in Mathlib?

Abstract:
Mathlib is a huge library that includes some advanced results,
but sometimes misses much more trivial theorems.
In this talk I will highlight some holes in the Mathlib library,
from simple tasks that can be done by a new user
to some big projects in analysis and dynamical systems
that I would love to see completed in a few years.
